issue.title: 広告アカウントのwrite権限と提案内容を反映する機能の実装

summary: Implement live preview and explicit-confirmation API routes for campaign status and budget only, with scope, entitlement, conflict, audit, and rollback controls.
decisions: Media mutation stays outside Agent tools and runs only in authenticated API routes.
Campaign status and budget are the only allowed writes; campaign creation, ads, bids, and other mutations are excluded.
Production launches with GOOGLE_ADS_WRITE_ENABLED=false and uses a separate enablement approval.

risks.description: A value may change between preview and execution.
risks.mitigation: Re-read immediately before mutation and return 409 on mismatch.

risks.description: A media change could run without valid human intent.
risks.mitigation: Require auth, workspace scope, active billing, entitlement, feature flag, confirmed=true, approval metadata, and an audit record.

risks.description: Staging status may not be restored.
risks.mitigation: Use only ENABLED/PAUSED and require re-read restore proof before evidence is accepted.

gates.description: Verify fail-closed guards, audit redaction, and absence of Agent mutation tools.
Approve one reversible ENABLED/PAUSED staging campaign round trip.
Separate approval is required before enabling the production write flag.

acceptanceCriteria: Only status and budget candidates can reach execution.
Preview and execution validate the same workspace-scoped real customer and campaign IDs.
A stale expected value returns 409 without mutation.
Success and failure records contain redacted approval metadata, before/after, audit ID, and rollback linkage.
The UI presents target, observed value/time, proposed value, rationale, risk, rollback, checkbox, result, and restore action.

rollback.strategy: Disable GOOGLE_ADS_WRITE_ENABLED; restore the staging campaign status through the linked rollback path; leave read-only surfaces available.
rollback.verification: Re-read the campaign, match the original value, and confirm the restore audit references the original audit ID.
